node.title: Re^3: rt://46333 links to rt.perl.org not rt.cpan.org
node.author: kcott
node.doctext:
G'day [id://830549|haukex],

That seemed like a reasonable comment when I read it; however, I then read [id://170442|jdporter]'s [id://1182763|response]: the "current behavior" is actually only very recent behaviour.

Anyway, as per his [id://1182783|subsequent response], the current behaviour is back to the original behaviour. The link I put in my private scratchpad ([rt://46333]), to initially check the reported problem, now resolves to http://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=46333, so this is again working as documented.

Having said that, there are two documentation issues. When the change to [rt://] was made ("on 2016-12-21"):

  • it was not documented in "[id://43037]"
  • there was no notification in "[id://545862]"

— Ken
